title: Quick loadouts
state.changed: Equipment changed. Review the plan again.
state.partial: Stopped; review current equipment and medicines
medicine.confirm: Changing medicines follows the game’s charge rules. Undo cannot restore medicine charges. Continue?
medicine.undoExcluded: Undo restores weapons and accessories, not medicines or charges
guidance.actual: Uses your actual upgrades, soul forging and refinement
guidance.candidate: Conditional recommendation; highest damage not established
guidance.priority: Equip owned accessories in priority order within unlocked slots
guidance.exact: Requires all six accessories and slots
preset.first_valley.name: Valley dual blades
preset.first_valley.summary: Use after acquiring both main and shadow weapons; keep healing available.
preset.first_valley.rotation: At dual-blade level 5, prepare the weapon buff and use heavy combos in openings. Switch weapons when killing intent is low and switching is available.
preset.first_forest.name: Forest dual blades
preset.first_forest.summary: Requires the fist weapon, swordsman weapon and dual-wield accessory; favor the dual blades.
preset.first_forest.rotation: Charged fist attacks require level 5. Buff the dual blades, attack in openings and switch weapons to recover ordinary killing intent.
preset.first_dual.name: Dual axes and hooks
preset.first_dual.summary: Switch after acquiring both weapons and bringing their upgrades close to your current main weapon.
preset.first_dual.rotation: Build the axes’ enhanced state through valid hits. At hook level 15, use successful counters to create damage and shield-breaking windows.
preset.first_heavy.name: Heavy-attack setup
preset.first_heavy.summary: Add the heavy-combo accessory when obtained; retain healing for exploration.
preset.first_heavy.rotation: Use killing-intent-consuming combos in safe openings. Switch when resources run low; use counters or the fist weapon against shields.
preset.first_fan.name: Fist and fan loop
preset.first_fan.summary: Requires the fan and martial-weapon resource accessory. The fan’s damage field requires level 5.
preset.first_fan.rotation: Place the field where combat will continue. Build fist power, land main-weapon heavy hits for temporary dark energy and spend it on the fist weapon.
preset.first_late.name: Late-game exploration
preset.first_late.summary: Requires forged dual blades and the mask and martial-weapon resource accessories. Fill only unlocked accessory slots.
preset.first_late.rotation: Prepare the fan field and fist power, attack with the forged dual blades and use hooks for counters and shields. Switch when ordinary killing intent runs low.
preset.ngplus_burst.name: Two-charge ultimate burst
preset.ngplus_burst.summary: Requires two pure killing-intent charges and enough time for both awakening and the finisher to connect.
preset.ngplus_burst.rotation: Mark with the snake blades, switch to the forged sword and prepare buffs. Confirm a break before awakening, then leave enough time for the second ultimate.
preset.ngplus_ultimate.name: Single-charge ultimate loop
preset.ngplus_ultimate.summary: Build charges through valid hits. Weapon switching does not restore pure killing intent.
preset.ngplus_ultimate.rotation: Build a charge through main-weapon hits, spend it during a break, then rebuild. A defensive ultimate may miss the accessories’ break-damage conditions.
preset.ngplus_physical.name: Sustained physical damage
preset.ngplus_physical.summary: For sustained close-range attacks. Switching weapons removes the axes’ enhanced state.
preset.ngplus_physical.rotation: Prepare field and fist buffs, build the axes’ state and attack. Switch to the forged dual blades when the state ends or ordinary killing intent runs low.
preset.ngplus_counter.name: Counter and break shields
preset.ngplus_counter.summary: Use hook counters to open shield-breaking windows. The counter accessory has a short perfect-guard trigger.
preset.ngplus_counter.rotation: Counter with the hooks, attack the shield during the buff and follow up after it breaks. Not every counter counts as a perfect guard.
preset.ngplus_shield.name: Forced shield break
preset.ngplus_shield.summary: For shields without reliable counter opportunities; trades some sustained damage for shield pressure.
preset.ngplus_shield.rotation: Use the axe and heavy main weapons on shield durability, then attack after the break. Account for the power-weapon accessory’s extra dark-energy cost.
preset.ngplus_lightning.name: Lightning weakness
preset.ngplus_lightning.summary: Applies to actual lightning damage and valid target parts, not every hit in the loadout.
preset.ngplus_lightning.rotation: Build the wind and lightning states, activate the buff and sustain attacks. Use the spear for extra damage and valid main-weapon hits for pure killing intent.
preset.ngplus_fire.name: Fire synergy
preset.ngplus_fire.summary: For fire weakness. Reconsider the setup against fire immunity or a new phase.
preset.ngplus_fire.rotation: Prepare the field and use the forged fire blade and fire shadow weapon in valid openings. Appearance alone does not establish an elemental weakness.
preset.ngplus_frost.name: Frost and water / snow counters
preset.ngplus_frost.summary: Use the fork for emergence mechanics. The white blade does not deal ice damage on every hit.
preset.ngplus_frost.rotation: Hit the valid water or snow target with the fork, then spend heavy attacks or ultimates after confirming the break.
preset.ngplus_chaos.name: Chaos and phantom counters
preset.ngplus_chaos.summary: First satisfy the phantom’s damage conditions. Chaos and the pipa do not bypass all story invulnerability.
preset.ngplus_chaos.rotation: Use chaos against compatible phantom states, then pipa and forged sword attacks in damage windows. Ring recovery requires actual enemy killing-intent loss.
preset.ngplus_poison.name: Poison in long fights
preset.ngplus_poison.summary: For fights long enough to build poison; short openings may not repay the setup.
preset.ngplus_poison.rotation: Land throwing-knife hits to build poison while maintaining main-weapon attacks. Reassess using actual resistance and fight duration.
preset.ngplus_mounted.name: Mounted phase
preset.ngplus_mounted.summary: The rider accessory requires actual mounted or horse tags. Reconsider after dismounting.
preset.ngplus_mounted.rotation: Use hook counters and shield pressure during the mounted phase. Manually select another preset once the enemy dismounts.
preset.ngplus_exploration.name: NG+ exploration
preset.ngplus_exploration.summary: Balances sustained damage and survival using your actual equipment upgrades.
preset.ngplus_exploration.rotation: Prepare the fan and fist buffs, attack with the forged dual blades and use hooks for shields and counters. Switch to recover ordinary killing intent.
preset.ngplus_survival.name: Steady defense and recovery
preset.ngplus_survival.summary: The armor fragment, bracers, bitter-leaf medicine and fan reduce damage; the maternal charm heals on your own guard break and the beads shorten recovery. At the recommended upgrades, with maximum armor effect, intact guard, medicine and field active, the physical/elemental damage factor is 0.2016 (79.84% reduction).
preset.ngplus_survival.rotation: Use bitter-leaf medicine and place the fan field before taking pressure. Raise the shield briefly and lower it before killing intent runs out; counterattack and heal in openings. At maximum level, the medicine reduces damage by 40% for 25 seconds. Leaving the field removes its reduction. On your own guard break, the charm heals and the beads shorten recovery; use burst healing in emergencies. Do not deliberately break your guard or treat healing as death prevention.
preset.chiren_skill.name: Blazing Blade skill build
preset.chiren_skill.summary: Skill-oriented accessories with killing-intent recovery. Keep all current weapons. Three attack, two support and one survival accessory; effects use actual refinement.
preset.chiren_skill.rotation: Use blade skills from a safe distance; the ranged accessory signals its active range with a flashing red lock-on dot. Low killing-intent damage scales with the remaining resource; do not deliberately empty it. Use the recommended medicines as needed; shown medicine effects assume level 6.
preset.killing_intent_combo.name: Killing-intent combo set
preset.killing_intent_combo.summary: General killing-intent combo damage and reduced cost, with ultimate charge gain. Requires five accessories and preserves a legal current accessory in the remaining slot. Keep all current weapons.
preset.killing_intent_combo.rotation: Use killing-intent-consuming combos, with the recommended medicines as needed. The combo catalyst ignites the player. Low killing-intent damage depends on the remaining resource; do not deliberately empty it. Medicine references assume level 6; actual effects use the current level.
preset.pojun.name: Army Breaker set
preset.pojun.summary: Movement-combo accessories with brief protection after weapon switching, reduced cost and additional killing-intent capacity. Six fixed accessories; keep all current weapons.
preset.pojun.rotation: Follow weapon-switch protection with moving combos. The fan scales with attack movement; the combo accessory requires consecutive hits. The heavy-weapon accessory applies to two-handed weapons. Use the classic combo medicines at their actual levels.
slot.preserveRemaining: Keep legal current accessories in the remaining slots
state.invalid: Duplicate items, locked slots or category limits
state.swap: Arrange weapon or medicine slots manually before applying this loadout
state.failedMedicines: Stopped; weapons and accessories restored. Check medicines and remaining uses
